Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Отменить STAR?

In this glossary, Отменить STAR refers to: An instruction to terminate the Standard Terminal Arrival Route procedure.

How is Отменить STAR used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Пилот, отмените STAR и следуйте указаниям ATC для прибытия."

Why does Отменить STAR matter in aviation?

Отменить STAR matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Отменить STAR?

Отменить STAR is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Отменить STAR belong to?

In this glossary, Отменить STAR is grouped under Basic ATC. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

An instruction to terminate the Standard Terminal Arrival Route procedure.

Operational example

Pilot, cancel STAR and follow ATC instructions for arrival.
